title: School health camp
body: During a school health camp, a doctor examined four students of Class 6 and asked each of them about their daily diet. Student P had bleeding gums, and small cuts on his hands were taking a long time to heal. Student Q found it hard to see things in dim light in the evening. Student R often felt weak and became short of breath quickly while climbing stairs. Student S had soft bones, and her legs were slightly bent. The doctor told the students that each problem was linked to the lack of a particular vitamin or mineral in the diet over a long time, and suggested changes in what they eat. She also asked some of them to spend time playing outdoors in the morning.
